core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hanaan corresponds to the Arabic form حنان (Arabic root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n); حَنَان (Ḥanān)). Its core sense is grace, beauty, compassion. Hanaan is Arabic حَنَان (Ḥanān) 'tenderness, compassion, mercy, affection', from the root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n). The word appears in the Qur'an. The source gloss 'graceful, pleasing' is a loose rendering; 'tenderness, compassion' is the lexical sense. Same name as hanan and hannan.

faq.a: Hanaan is associated with the Arabic form حنان, whose core sense is grace, beauty, compassion.

faq.q: What is the origin of Hanaan?
faq.a: Hanaan is associated with Arabic. Hanaan is Arabic حَنَان (Ḥanān) 'tenderness, compassion, mercy, affection', from the root ح ن ن (ḥ-n-n). The word appears in the Qur'an. The source gloss 'graceful, pleasing' is a loose rendering; 'tenderness, compassion' is the lexical sense. Same name as hanan and hannan.
Yes — the underlying form حنان is Arabic.
Hanaan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Hanaan should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. True

faq.q: What does Hanaan mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Hanaan is rendered حنان and carries the sense فضل، حسن، شفقت.

faq.q: What does Hanaan mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Hanaan is rendered حنان and carries the sense لطف، زیبایی، دلسوزی.
A romanized syllable approximation is ha-naan. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Hanaan?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Hanaan, hanaan, hanan. Script forms are حنان, हनान.

faq.q: Is Hanaan a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
